integrity: Mathematical proof with deterministic symbolic/finite-ring cross-checks; no independent audit, no claim of an independently derived full stationary law.
scientific_limitations: Stationary spatial two-point function only, with ring thermodynamic limit taken before separation goes to infinity.
The sharp spatial disorder line is not a nonanalyticity of the free energy.
Original finite-ring stationary probabilities and update rules are credited to Ayyer and Podder.
Related complex-pole mechanisms are established in other lattice models; this analysis specifies the NED curve and critical behavior.
title: A sharp disorder line for the three-neighbour evaporation–deposition automaton
